about_the_game:
Enter Quizverse – a relaxed and clever quiz game that tests your knowledge in a fun way!
Whether you're a logic fan, science enthusiast or just curious, Quizverse challenges you with exciting questions from a wide range of topics and lets you try to beat your high score.

With its varied but challenging questions, Quizverse offers the perfect blend of learning and entertainment – ideal for short breaks or long brainstorming sessions.

Key features:

  • Different game modes: Test your knowledge in Free Play mode or under time pressure in 100-second mode.

  • Wide range of topics: geography, history, sport, film & music, technology, science and more.

  • Relaxing and challenging gameplay: designed for single players – no stress, just you and your knowledge.

  • Score attack & high score tracking: Challenge yourself, improve your score and compare yourself with the high scores of others.

Whether you're playing for just a few minutes or diving into the high score marathon, Quizverse makes knowledge fun again.

Test your knowledge, discover new things and become the master of Quizverse!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or AMD FX-4100
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 710 or AMD Radeon HD 6450
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Yes
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 or AMD Radeon R7 250X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Yes
